intended_object: The lexicographic relation on finitely supported dependent functions Π₀ i, α i, with the index type ordered by r and each fibre α i ordered by s i (from the docstring). It is used for both the Lex and the Colex orders.
explanation: The body is Pi.Lex r (s _) applied to x and y viewed as functions. Pi.Lex says: there is an index i such that x j = y j for all j with r j i, and s i (x i) (y i). This is exactly the standard lexicographic comparison. With r = (· > ·) it becomes the colexicographic order, as the docstring states; this works because the functions are finitely supported, so a largest index where they differ exists. The relations r and s are arbitrary, and the only assumption is Zero on each α i, which is needed just to form Π₀. So the definition is fully general and agrees with its docstring.
